how_to_raise: Edit this file in the SAME pull request that grows the number, set limit to the new ceiling, update measured and measured_on, and justify the growth in the PR body (what was added, why it cannot be smaller, what it cost). A budget is raised by a reviewed decision, never to make a red run green.

binary_bytes.what: Size in bytes of the STRIPPED ARM plxnative binary that `make ipk FLAVOR=debug` stages into the package (ipkroot/data/usr/palm/applications/<appid>/plxnative), as the CI cross-build job builds it: `make ipk FLAVOR=debug` with RELEASE unset, so the Makefile's dev feature set (both playback backends plus devtools, devtriggers and threadcheck), the fat-LTO `release` cargo profile (CI selects it by itself) and a stripped binary. The shipped RELEASE=1 binary is built with the shipping feature set (no devtools, devtriggers or threadcheck) and is smaller; this is the number CI can measure on every PR.
binary_bytes.headroom: 14% (limit raised from 18,750,000 to 20,000,000 by the owner for the URI-first playback build/package matrix series; the dev binary links both playback backends)

packages_default.what: Third-party (registry/git) packages the app crate compiles for armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi with its DEFAULT features: normal + build dependencies, dev-dependencies excluded, workspace members excluded.
packages_default.headroom: 0 (exact measured graph, including the reviewed STORE ZIP reader/writer and the verify-only ed25519-compact)

packages_no_default_features.what: The same count with the shipping feature set: the Makefile's `RELEASE=1` flags (--no-default-features plus the playback backends, asked of `make print-playback-config`), which is what every shipped binary is built with.
packages_no_default_features.headroom: 0 (exact measured graph, including the reviewed STORE ZIP reader/writer and the verify-only ed25519-compact)

duplicate_versions_default.what: Crate names present in more than one version in the NORMAL-edge graph for the default feature set (the set `cargo tree -d --edges normal --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi` prints).

duplicate_versions_no_default_features.what: The same count with the shipping feature set (see packages_no_default_features).

source_lines.what: Lines of Rust under rust-modules/src, rust-modules/base/src, rust-modules/machine/src, rust-modules/net/src, rust-modules/platform/src, rust-modules/gfx/src, rust-modules/ui/src, rust-modules/plex/src, rust-modules/telemetry/src, rust-modules/data/src, rust-modules/session/src, rust-modules/media/src, rust-modules/playback-contract/src, rust-modules/media-codecs/src, rust-modules/play-feed/src, rust-modules/play-uri/src, rust-modules/appkit/src and rust-modules/screens/src (every .rs file). Informational: exceeding it warns and never fails, because a growing feature is not a build-health defect by itself.
